content: We consider fine-grained (5-class) classification on Stanford Sentiment Treebank BIBREF24. The labels are negative, somewhat_negative, neutral, positive and somewhat_positive. Our model was based on the biattentive classification network BIBREF25. We used all phrase lengths in the dataset for training, but test results are reported only on full sentences, following prior work.
